Read only source /evidence/source.json, parent /evidence/parent.json, and independent audit /evidence/audit.json. Do not use the web, any prior-run file other than those exact sealed inputs, any other solution, or any verification report. You may create exact-arithmetic checks only under /work; do not modify files outside /work.

This is an exact-closure attempt after the three scheduled search lenses. Concentrate on resolving the independent audit. If no material proof change is required, copy claimed_resolution, every claim and proof_sketch, and final_writeup from the parent exactly.

Address every REFUTED or UNRESOLVED claim and the audit's target-coverage judgment. Preserve correct progress. Repair, narrow, replace, or remove unsupported claims. Never call the open target solved without a complete proof at the requested strength. Put every load-bearing claim in a separate results item in proof order. There is no claim-count cap. The entire ordered proof is in scope. Keep final_writeup under 3,000 words and each proof_sketch under 500 words.

      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "After independently transforming each chosen physical card, orient its arc from hoop to ball. The swish condition says every occupied vertex has exactly one outgoing and one incoming arc, so the finite arc graph is a disjoint union of directed simple cycles. Each cycle component, using distinct physical copies, is itself a swish. Conversely, the cards realizing any directed simple cycle put exactly one hoop and one ball at every cycle vertex and nothing elsewhere, hence form a swish. This proves the equivalence with copy multiplicities respected.",

      "claim_sha256": "495d208fe9451d7b40bac4ad3456526a7c04fbe0ea336433d3b11909d55f5b97",
      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "Exact Klein-four enumeration gives position-orbit sizes 4,2,4,2, 36 transformation types, eight internal types with profile 3,1,3,1, and 28 cross-orbit types in 14 distinct reversal pairs. Both members of a cross reversal pair realize opposite arcs and hence a 2-cycle, so at most 14 cross types occur. On each four-point orbit, all three internal types realize a directed triangle, so at most two occur; each two-point orbit has only one internal type. Thus the support is at most 14+2+1+2+1=20. Taking one forward type from every reversal pair in a fixed orbit order, two internal types on each four-point orbit, and one on each two-point orbit gives 20 types. Cross arcs strictly increase orbit rank, while exact local cycle enumeration confirms the six internal cards are acyclic, proving sharpness.",
      "witness": "The sharp construction has 14 forward cross-orbit types and six internal types, for 20 distinct types, with no multiplicity-respecting directed cycle.",
      "search_method": "Exact symmetry-orbit enumeration, reversal pairing, exhaustive local simple-cycle enumeration, and verification of the orbit-order construction.",

    },
    {
      "idx": 2,
      "claim": "Unless all eight internal types are duplicated, the usual once-or-twice interpretation of the 60-card deck already yields a 29-card no-swish subset.",
      "claim_sha256": "224292f0e61fb70b473ba34c2c08f3e1a5ba8c4daed06e2bfa345fe372a14edb",
      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "Under the stated once-or-twice convention, if an internal type is not doubled then the internal-card total M0 is at most 15. Six cycle-free internal types can always be selected. Every physical cross card is forward in exactly 12 of the 24 total orders of the four position orbits, so some order selects at least ceil((60-M0)/2) cross cards. The worst case M0=15 gives 6+ceil(45/2)=29. Cross arcs strictly increase the selected orbit order, and the internal selection is locally acyclic, so the resulting collection is no-swish.",
      "witness": "At M0=15, the averaging construction selects at least 23 cross cards plus six safe internal cards, totaling 29; smaller M0 only improves the bound.",
      "search_method": "Checked all 24 orbit orders symbolically and evaluated the exact integer lower bound for every M0 from 8 through 15.",
      "checker_path": "<workspace-home>/paired_v2_fixed_point_extension_v3_scratch/fun2026_swish_29_cards/audit/plain/attempt_6/swish_audit_attempt6_checker.py"
    },

      "idx": 3,
      "claim": "The direct orbit-order construction yields 29 cards unless all eight internal types are doubled and duplicated cross types are direction-balanced between every pair of position orbits.",
      "claim_sha256": "819e161ebb9ba8f0824e5343c28f63e8758f291961b3a63432043339bc63f26a",
      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "When all eight internal types are doubled, the 60-card once-or-twice model has exactly 16 doubled cross types. For an orbit order, its forward-extra score S has average 8 because each doubled cross type is forward in half of the 24 orders. If d_ij differs from d_ji, choose an order with i,j adjacent and swap them; every other comparison is unchanged while the mutual contribution changes, so S is nonconstant. Since S is integral with average 8, some order has S at least 9, yielding 6 safe internal cards, 14 baseline cross types, and at least nine extras: 29 cards. If every d_ij=d_ji, each unordered orbit pair contributes the same amount in either order and every score equals 8, so this template gives 28. The draft correctly limits the converse to this construction.",
      "witness": "Exact enumeration covered 148578 feasible directed count vectors with total 16: all 148392 asymmetric vectors had maximum score at least 9, while all 186 balanced vectors had constant score 8.",
      "search_method": "Adjacent-swap proof plus exhaustive enumeration of every feasible d_ij count vector and all 24 orbit orders.",
      "checker_path": "<workspace-home>/paired_v2_fixed_point_extension_v3_scratch/fun2026_swish_29_cards/audit/plain/attempt_6/swish_audit_attempt6_checker.py"
    },

      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "The source states that the commercial deck has 60 physical cards and 36 symmetry types but does not identify which types are duplicated. Two explicit once-or-twice multiplicity vectors consistent with those aggregates give opposite outcomes. Deck X doubles all eight internal types and both directions of eight reversal pairs. Any no-swish subset then has at most six internal cards, at most two cards from each of those eight pairs, and at most one from each remaining pair, totaling 28; the orbit-order construction attains 28. Deck Y doubles all 14 backward cross types relative to a fixed order, nine forward types, and one internal type. Selecting both copies of the nine forward types, one copy of each other forward type, and six safe internal cards gives a 29-card no-swish subset. Both vectors have 60 cards, 36 represented types, and exactly 24 doubled types. Thus the supplied aggregate information cannot determine which branch holds for the fixed commercial deck.",
